requirement: Hit set remains stable; counts match only a defined event contract

inputs.name: three_identical_calls
inputs.call: subject.gd:run(1) three times in the same process

obligations.note: hit=true after any number of calls >= 1; this obligation is scoped to reached-at-least-once, not a specific count

notes: Calling the same function three times with the same input returns the same result each time (deterministic, no hidden state), and the line's hit status stays true -- it does not toggle or reset between calls within one process. This oracle deliberately does NOT assert a specific hit *count* (e.g. exactly 3): the schema's obligations are reached/not-reached facts, not counters, and different tools may legitimately report count semantics differently (e.g. once per line vs. once per statement vs. per-invocation). The requirement this fixture documents is narrower and tool-agnostic: whatever counting convention a tool uses, it must be a defined, consistent contract -- not a value that drifts across repeated identical calls. Confirmed on the pinned Godot 4.7.1 engine via pilot/fixtures/driver.gd.
author: godot-tooling-session-2026-09-19
ambiguities: This fixture cannot, by itself, catch a tool that reports a wrong but internally-consistent count (e.g. always reporting count=1 regardless of actual invocations) -- doing so would require the oracle to commit to one specific counting convention, which the schema does not yet define. That is a real gap, noted here rather than papered over.
